entities.summary: Mario Pacchioli (b. 1981-05-01, Ilanz) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ilanz and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, composers & musicians, europe.
